You will design investigative research problems that are difficult for advanced AI systems to solve, even with web access, and document a complete, auditable evidence trail. Strong open-web research skills and comfort investigating unfamiliar subjects from scratch. Native or near-native written English. Precise sourcing at the page, table, and section level.
